bundle.shortDescription: Digi Setu — local AI coding companion
bundle.longDescription: Digi Setu desktop runs the Digi Setu coding agent against folders on your own machine. Pick a folder, chat with the agent, watch it edit files, terminals, and PDFs — all local, with shadow-git checkpoints so every AI edit is revertable.
